```lean
theorem lg_target {G : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} 
  [AddCommGroup G] [LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedAddMonoid G] 
  [AddCommGroup H] [PartialOrder H] [IsOrderedAddMonoid H] 
  {f : G → H} 
  (h₁ : ∀ (x : G), f (-x) = -f x) 
  (h₂ : StrictAntiOn f (Set.Ici 0)) : StrictAnti f := by
  intro x y hxy
  cases' le_total 0 x with h1 h2
  cases' le_total 0 y with k1 k2
  rcases hxy with hxy | hxy
  · have h3 : 0 ≤ x := h1
    have h4 : 0 ≤ y := k1
    exact h₂.2 h3 h4 hxy
  · have h5 : x ≤ 0 := h2
    have h6 : y ≤ 0 := k2
    have h7 : -y ≤ -x := by rw [h₁, h₁]; exact le_neg_of_neg_le h6 h5
    have h8 : 0 ≤ -x := by rw [h₁]; exact le_neg_of_neg_le h5 h3
    have h9 : 0 ≤ -y := by rw [h₁]; exact le_neg_of_neg_le h6 h4
    exact h₂.2 h8 h9 h7
  · have h10 : x ≤ 0 := h2
    have h11 : y ≤ 0 := k2
    have h12 : -y ≤ -x := by rw [h₁, h₁]; exact le_neg_of_neg_le h11 h10
    have h13 : 0 ≤ -x := by rw [h₁]; exact le_neg_of_neg_le h10 h3
    have h14 : 0 ≤ -y := by rw [h₁]; exact le_neg_of_neg_le h11 h4
    exact h₂.2 h13 h14 h12
  · have h15 : 0 ≤ x := h1
    have h16 : y ≤ 0 := k2
    have h17 : -y ≤ -x := by rw [h₁, h₁]; exact le_neg_of_neg_le h16 h15
    have h18 : 0 ≤ -x := by rw [h₁]; exact le_neg_of_neg_le h15 h3
    have h19 : 0 ≤ -y := by rw [h₁]; exact le_neg_of_neg_le h16 h4
    exact h₂.2 h18 h19 h17
```
